title: Protect the Night, Control the Light!

context_sources.name: Landsat program
context_sources.role: Multispectral imagery for the vegetation index

context_sources.name: Falchi and Bara 2023
context_sources.role: Evidence that light pollution is rising

limitations: The entropy, distance, and competition formulas print with missing or displaced symbols.
The notation table misaligns several symbols with their descriptions.
The suburban score is 2.114942 in Table 2 and 1.414942 in Table 3.
The summary's 2, 6, and 3 percent reductions are not recomputed in the body.
Page 23, the flier, has no text layer and was read from the page image.

tasks: Build a broadly applicable light pollution risk metric covering humans and non-humans
Apply it to a protected, rural, suburban, and urban location
Design three intervention strategies with specific actions
Choose the best strategy for two locations and publish a flier

section_map.summary: Scores 0.36 to 3.20 and a win for lowering the intensity, at about 6 percent.
The gasoline-rainbow analogy, three components, and a promise to keep the ground lit.
Four tasks commissioned by the Illumination Control Mission.
Three lamp types, frozen slow variables, and weights that travel.
Entropy weights and TOPSIS over four exposures, summed into one score.
Futian, Guangming, Pingshan, and Wutong Mountain scored and explained.
A lamp competition, a radiance cut, and a layout reform, each with its cost.
Lowering the radiance wins for both tested districts.
Radiance moves the score by 10 percent, the other indicators by 4.
Five skies, four warnings, and three actions for the reader.

contributions.summary: Each victim group gets its own risk before the four are added.
The spectrum enters through the lamp mix, matched to the group it harms most.
The lamp replacement is a competition, so the old lamp fights back.
The winning strategy is the one aimed at the most sensitive indicator.

dependency_graph.handoff: The scoring rule grades the four Shenzhen districts.
The radiance and the lamp shares are the quantities the strategies move.
The fifty-year paths supply the reductions that are compared.

assumptions.summary: Lamps fall into LED, fluorescent, and other.
Indicators left out of the model matter little.
Population, vegetation, species richness, and lamp efficiency stay fixed.
Weights fitted on four districts apply anywhere.
Without intervention the total radiance stays constant.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Luojia 1-01 digital numbers converted to radiance by the official calibration.
Vegetation cover from the normalized difference index on a Landsat image.
Population density and radiance averaged inside each district boundary.
Milan's lamp change read from astronaut photographs in 2012 and 2015.

models.summary: Scores a place by entropy weighting and TOPSIS over four exposures.
Grades four Shenzhen districts from overlaid satellite maps.
Projects the lamp replacement as a competition over fifty years.
Picks the strategy with the largest, steadiest reduction.

verification.summary: Each odd score is checked against what the district contains.
A ten percent move in radiance changes the score by about 10 percent, and the other indicators by about 4.
Varying the decline rate leaves the final lamp share and its trend intact.

results_trace.summary: The untreated urban score rises for about seventeen years before easing.
The layout strategy moves the scores by only 0.012859 and 0.040786.
Lowering the radiance is the most effective strategy for both districts.
The three strategies cut the score by about 2, 6, and 3 percent.

writing_logic.summary: Open with an analogy that turns a beauty into a pollutant.
Keep the benefit while promising to cut the harm.
Follow every assumption with its explanation.
Reject the usual tool before offering the new one.
State the principle of the method before its algebra.
Price each strategy in the same breath as its benefit.
Show the untreated path before the treated one.
Return to the opening image in the conclusion.

language_observations.summary: The gasoline rainbow does the work of a definition.
The ground staying lit is the condition on every remedy.
An odd score is explained by what the place lacks.
The cost of dimming is written as a list of social consequences.
The flier repeats the paper's own slogan as its banner.

visualization_observations.summary: Figure 1 pairs an orbital night image with a street-level trespass photo.
Figure 2 flowcharts the work from the metric to the strategies.
Figure 3 lays out the indicator hierarchy.
Figure 4 plots the fluorescent and LED spectra.
Figure 6 locates the four Shenzhen districts.
Figures 7 and 8 map vegetation and population density.
Figures 9 and 10 give the dimension scores and the grades.
Figure 12 shows Milan's lamp change from orbit.
Figure 13 contrasts directional and shielded fixtures.
Figures 14 and 15 plot the fifty-year risk paths.
Figures 16 and 17 test the indicators and the decline rate.
The flier runs five panels from a washed-out city sky to a starred reserve.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: A judge rewards scoring people, plants, wildlife, and energy separately before combining them.
A judge rewards stating the social cost of a strategy next to its benefit.
A judge penalizes two tables that give the same district different scores.

weaknesses.summary: The notation table misaligns symbols and descriptions.
The entropy and distance formulas lost their summation signs.
The competition equations print with displaced divisors.
The rates and competitiveness coefficients are never given.
The suburban score disagrees between Table 2 and Table 3.
The percentage reductions are stated only in the summary.
The negative impacts of the strategies are never quantified.
Weights from four districts are declared valid worldwide.

independent_extensions.statement: Reconcile the two suburban scores and recompute the layout strategy's effect from one consistent baseline.
independent_extensions.reason: The printed change of 0.040786 depends on a starting value that contradicts the earlier result.

independent_extensions.statement: Quantify the crime and night-economy costs of the dimming strategy and fold them into the comparison.
independent_extensions.reason: The paper itself lists these costs and then lets the radiance reduction win without weighing them.

candidate_rule_impacts.impact: Supports projecting a technology replacement as a two-species competition over a stated horizon.
Supports choosing the intervention whose target is also the most sensitive indicator.

unresolved_questions: Which suburban score, 2.114942 or 1.414942, is the intended baseline.
What rates and competitiveness coefficients generate the fifty-year lamp paths.
How large the crime and economic costs of dimming are relative to the 6 percent gain.
